visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man in a black t-shirt with 'SHANE' printed on it and a young woman with reddish hair tied back are standing in an indoor room with light wood floors and white walls. The man is adjusting a laptop on a keyboard stand, while the woman holds a microphone near a music stand. They are facing each other and talking. (2) The woman begins singing into the microphone, her expressions animated. The man stands beside her, moving rhythmically and making hand gestures to the beat. Yellow and blue captions appear at the bottom. The background features a large whiteboard and some professional lighting equipment. (3) The man takes on a teaching role, pointing and gesturing towards the woman as if giving performance notes. Close-up shots show their expressive faces and laughter. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the studio-like space. (4) A fast-paced montage shows the two performing the song with high energy. The woman sings with large hand gestures while the man dances and poses nearby. Large red and yellow text overlays '實戰演練' appear prominently. (5) The man and woman high-five each other, smiling broadly at the camera. The man wipes sweat from his forehead. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing their final interaction in a celebratory mood.
